market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC trading ~$81-82K on May 6 2026. Question requires a ~38% drawdown to $50K within ~8 months. Historical BTC drawdowns of this magnitude exist (2022 bear, FTX) but are rare in non-recession environments. With BTC already off ~15% YoY and consolidating, base rate of a 38% drop within 8 months is roughly 10-15%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shock or major exchange/regulatory event could trigger a deeper drawdown.
